h1: IMPACT Challenger Muang Thong Thani Serviced Apartment — A Full-Kitchen Apartment 15-Min Walk From IMPACT Challenger Hall
intro: If you're heading to IMPACT Muang Thong Thani in a group or family and want a room where you can actually cook — not just crash — IMPACT Challenger Muang Thong Thani Serviced Apartment is the option most people overlook · It's a 31-unit serviced apartment in Popular Condo Building T8 on Popular 3 Road in Pak Kret, sitting about 1.2 km from the IMPACT halls — a 15-minute walk or a 3-minute ride · Every room comes with a microwave, fridge and electric kettle; and the property offers family rooms (two king beds) and multi-bed configurations that are genuinely rare in this area · Free parking, free Wi-Fi and a garden fill out the basics · The Pink Line MRT spur opened in May 2025, with MT01 station and a 230-metre covered skywalk leading straight to Challenger Hall — the station is about 10 minutes on foot from the apartment · Prices start from approx. ฿900/night.

body.html: IMPACT Challenger Muang Thong Thani Serviced Apartment sits inside Popular Condo Building T8 on Popular 3 Road in Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi Province · It's about 1.2 km from the IMPACT complex — walkable in around 15 minutes, or a very short 3-minute ride via Grab or Bolt · What sets it apart from every other nearby option is the full kitchen in each unit: a microwave, mini-fridge and electric kettle are standard across all room types. For groups on multi-day stays, being able to pop to the market and cook your own meals cuts costs dramatically compared with eating out three times a day · Room categories include a Studio (one double bed), a Triple (queen bed plus two futon pull-outs), a Family Room (two king beds) and a Quadruple (one king bed). That two-king-bed family room in particular is almost impossible to find at this price point in the IMPACT area.

Getting here has become meaningfully easier since the Pink Line MRT's Muang Thong Thani spur opened in May 2025 · Station MT01 (Impact Muang Thong Thani) now has a 230-metre covered skywalk that connects directly into Challenger Hall — so if you're coming in from central Bangkok for a concert or expo, you can step off the train and walk under cover straight to the venue · From the apartment itself it's about a 10-minute walk to reach MT01 · Don Muang Airport is approximately 10 km away (around 20 minutes by road). If you're driving, free parking in the Popular Condo complex makes this an easy base for a group arriving by car.
"Spacious rooms with a proper kitchen — a real find if you're here for a multi-day expo at IMPACT. Far cheaper than the hotels right by the halls, and the free parking sealed it for our group."

The facilities on site belong to the broader Popular Condo complex: a lift, 24-hour security staff, CCTV, a convenience store, a hair salon, a garden and some shuttle-service availability · What you will not find here is a hotel-style restaurant, a breakfast buffet, or a swimming pool · This is a condo building with units rented as short-stay accommodation, not a full-service hotel — and that distinction matters · Check-in is not staffed around the clock in the way a hotel lobby is; you should contact the property in advance to confirm your arrival time and get an emergency contact number · A review on one platform noted that customer service was difficult to reach and that some in-room basics — such as hot water, slippers and a hairdryer — were not as advertised. That is a single account, but it is worth verifying what is included with your booking before you arrive.

Pricing is genuinely low for the IMPACT area · A Studio unit runs from around ฿900/night in low season, and a Family Room with two king beds from around ฿1,200–฿1,500 depending on the dates · During major IMPACT events — the Motor Expo, big concerts, or large trade fairs — expect rates to climb 30–50% and rooms to sell out faster than you might expect · Comparing that against ibis Bangkok IMPACT (from ฿1,200) or Novotel Bangkok IMPACT (from ฿2,300+), this apartment is the most budget-friendly option in the area by a clear margin, though the trade-off is a longer walk to the halls and a much more self-service experience · For a group of three or four sharing a family room and splitting the cost, the per-head value here is hard to beat.

The honest summary is this: IMPACT Challenger Muang Thong Thani Serviced Apartment works very well for families or groups coming to IMPACT events who need a kitchen and are happy to manage themselves · The full kitchen, the large multi-bed rooms, the free parking and the newly opened MRT connection are genuine advantages that put it ahead of a simple budget hotel for certain travellers · But if you want round-the-clock front desk service, an in-house restaurant, a swimming pool and the ease of a full hotel — ibis Bangkok IMPACT or Botanic Service Room at Impact will serve you better, even at a slightly higher price · And if your main goal is sightseeing in central Bangkok rather than attending events, the Muang Thong Thani location is simply too far out for either.

honestSummary: IMPACT Challenger Muang Thong Thani Serviced Apartment is the strongest choice for families or groups attending IMPACT events who want a full kitchen and large rooms at a budget price · The kitchen, multi-bed rooms, free parking and the newly opened MRT connection are real advantages — but accept that it runs like a condo rental, not a hotel: check-in needs advance coordination, there's no restaurant, and some guests have reported gaps between what's advertised and what's in the room.
honestChecks: If you need hotel-style service: 24-hour front desk, in-house restaurant and a swimming pool — this is a condo rental, not a full-service hotel → ibis Bangkok IMPACT or Botanic Service Room at Impact will take better care of you.

If you're travelling alone or as a couple without a car — the per-person cost advantage shrinks, and the walk to IMPACT is longer than ibis or Botanic → weigh that against the kitchen benefit before you book.

If you're worried about in-room amenities — at least one reviewer found that basics like hot water, slippers and a hairdryer were not as listed → contact the property directly to confirm what's included before committing.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — IMPACT Challenger Muang Thong Thani Serviced Apartment

faq.q: Where is IMPACT Challenger Muang Thong Thani Serviced Apartment and how do I get to the IMPACT halls?
faq.a: It is in Popular Condo Building T8, Floor 2, Popular 3 Road, Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi · The IMPACT halls are about 1.2 km away — a 15-minute walk or a 3-minute ride with Grab or Bolt · The Pink Line MRT spur opened in May 2025: board the Pink Line, transfer at PK10 (Muang Thong Thani), alight at MT01 (Impact Muang Thong Thani) and use the 230-metre covered skywalk straight into Challenger Hall. The apartment is about 10 minutes on foot from MT01.

faq.q: Does every room really have a kitchen, and what room types are available?
faq.a: Yes — every unit includes a microwave, mini-fridge and electric kettle, plus a private bathroom, air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi · Room types: Studio (one double bed, from ~฿900) · Triple Room (queen bed + two futon pull-outs) · Family Room (two king beds, sleeps four) · Quadruple Room (one king bed) · The two-king-bed Family Room is especially hard to find at this price in the IMPACT area.

faq.q: Who is this apartment best for, and who should look elsewhere?
faq.a: Great for: families or groups of 3–4 coming to IMPACT events who want a full kitchen and large rooms at a low per-head cost — especially if driving, since parking is free · Look elsewhere if: you need 24-hour hotel-style front desk, a restaurant, a pool or the simplicity of a full hotel check-in → in those cases ibis Bangkok IMPACT or Botanic Service Room at Impact will serve you better.

faq.q: Is there free parking, and is it easy to drive here from Don Muang Airport?
faq.a: Free parking is available in the Popular Condo complex · Don Muang Airport is about 10 km away, roughly 20 minutes by car · If you are not driving, you can take the Pink Line MRT to Muang Thong Thani (PK10), switch to the spur line and ride to MT01, then walk about 10 minutes to the apartment — or take a Grab from the airport directly.

faq.q: What are the prices and do they spike around big IMPACT events?
faq.a: Low-season rates start from around ฿900/night for a Studio and ฿1,200–฿1,500 for a Family Room · During major events such as the Motor Expo, large concerts or international trade fairs, rates can climb 30–50% and rooms sell out quickly · Always book early and compare prices across Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com before committing.
